mechanical_choices.conditional_basis: independently standardized logTOTAL and raw logTOTAL square, train only
mechanical_choices.continuous7: unweighted median/IQR residual and labor coordinates; block weights only in clustering
mechanical_choices.regional_grand_mean: own reference region across municipalities and all 12 months, separately per channel; national fallback below 10 nodes
mechanical_choices.canonical_order: ascending observed median jobs/resident, O/P/Q share, then five percentage residuals; raw label tie break
mechanical_choices.unknown_status: municipal_district_type indicators; empty or unseen heldout type has zero dummy effects and explicit flag
mechanical_choices.quartile_ties: np.quantile linear thresholds and searchsorted side=right
mechanical_choices.null_sources: common positive-outdegree sources; relabeling strata preserve their degree
mechanical_choices.loro_sources: remove both region endpoints, intersect source sets of G/static/all199nulls, renormalize remaining degree; fewer than20sources yields UNDETERMINED/null
